text:
ana: Quick sync — need to lock the webinar slate and run a "blackbox" rehearsal this week. Goals: surface flaky demos, confirm fallback scripts, and validate host handoffs.

mike: +1. what exactly do you mean by blackbox rehearsal?

ana: We run the session with minimal stage notes for speakers. Ops triggers a surprise fail (network/cpu/embedding proxy) and we practice recovery without a full script. Think stress-test for fallbacks.

lisa: love that. suggests we also include a 3-min cold start demo where engineer plugs in without prep to validate onboarding flow.

devon: Speaker slate update: Marco confirmed, Jill tentative, and we asked an external panelist (TBC). Marco can do the deep-technical segment; Jill prefers product/benchmarks.

marco: confirmed — ok for the deep section. can do a short 10-slide deck + 5-min Q&A. will prepare a one-paragraph abstract by EOD tomorrow.

jill: tentative but leaning yes. can we make the abstract ~40 words and keep demos high-level?

mike: For abstracts, let's have two variants: customer-facing (marketing tone) and engineering-facing (benchmarks + configs). We'll iterate both.

ana: Good call. Drafts: please drop into this sheet: https://tiny.redwood/webinar-abstracts (edit rights). I'll tag edits and keep changelog.

devon: Rehearsal plan proposal:
- Wed 10am PT: content run (speakers + deck)
- Thu 11am PT: blackbox run (ops-only failures)
- Fri 3pm PT: dress w/producer + stream test
Can we trim any of these?

lisa: wed + thu + fri looks right. put 30m buffer between runs for quick fixes.

marco: Thu blackbox works for me. how do we communicate the failure modes to ops?

ana: Ops, please prepare 3 failure scenarios (order randomized):
1) model variant fallback (route to smaller quantized model)
2) embedding service timeout
3) low-gpu capacity -> autoscale fallback to CPU-compatible variant
Ops: simulate these by toggling routing in prod-like staging.

jill: For speaking segments, can we add a 90s canned fallback talking point each speaker can use if demo breaks? small paragraph in speaker notes.

mike: I'll draft fallback blurbs for product/benchmarks/ops. We'll keep them <90s.

deploy-bot: Calendar invites created for 2026-04-08T17:00Z, 2026-04-09T18:00Z, 2026-04-10T22:00Z. Links attached to the sheet.

ana: Run-of-show skeleton for the blackbox dress (short):
```
00:00 - Host intro (2m)
02:00 - Speaker 1 deep-tech (10m)
12:00 - Demo 1 (5m) 
17:00 - Panel + bench highlights (8m)
25:00 - Surprise fail/ops triggers (5m)
30:00 - Recovery + fallback script (6m)
36:00 - Q&A (8m)
44:00 - Close (1m)
```

devon: Note: during the fail segment, host should cue "ops intervention" and we should have a visible fallback banner in the stream. Ops to confirm banner assets.

marco: I'll send my abstract now — cc in the sheet. Also uploading slides v0.

jill: If I confirm, I'll write my 90s fallback and the two abstract variants by EOD Thu.

ana: Thanks team. Action items I have: collect abstracts, assign fallback blurbs (mike), get ops failure scripts (devon), schedule blackout rehearsal (deploy-bot). Will follow up with final run-of-show and a checklist for stream graphics. :sparkles:

mike: I'll post the engineering-facing abstract template in the sheet and add a short checklist for demo infra (env vars, keys, quick rollback commands).

deploy-bot: Reminder set: 24h before each rehearsal.

ana: Last ask — please keep messages in the sheet (not here) for final copy. Use this thread only for scheduling/fail modes. Cheers. :v:
